recommended_unapproved_proposal.design_intent: 비기와 노가다 없이 완주할 수 있지만 상성과 진형을 활용해야 하는 숙련자용 점증 하드

global_rules.mercenary_replacement_rule: occupied slots only; preserve combat role, movement constraints, and scenario terrain unless individually approved
global_rules.secret_scenario_rule: X1-X4 are tuned individually because entry timing and original stats differ too much for the main-story formula

scenario_steps.label: 본편 최종장
scenario_steps.summon_scope: four of six slots for major commanders; at most two of six for ordinary commanders

summon_policy.excluded_reason: 아니키는 비기·개그 성격이므로 기본 하드 편성에서 제외

exception_candidates.rule: 연출용 강적이므로 자동 능력치·용병 강화에서 제외
실기에서 적대 대상으로 확인된 진영 08 열 개를 21~24장 공식 대상에 포함하되 원본 진영 08은 보존
원작 이벤트가 진영을 바꾸는 특수 레코드이므로 고정 레코드 자동 강화에서 제외
아군 지원 이벤트이므로 모든 적 전용 보너스에서 제외
한 보스의 두 단계로 취급하고 중복 누적 금지
적대 최종 보스지만 X4 원본 수치가 본편 상한보다 높으므로 본편 공식·상한을 적용하지 않고 X4에서 개별 조정
비밀 시나리오는 본편 공식에서 제외하고 개별 조정

recommended_unapproved_proposal_preview.selection_policy: main-story side 04 plus the ten verified-hostile scenario-22 side-08 records, minus explicit automatic exclusions

conservative_preview.interpretation: replace at most the scenario quota per target commander; never fill empty slots and never replace an already-unmapped top unit merely to reach a numeric quota

role_aware_preview.interpretation: replace at most the scenario quota per target commander; never fill empty slots and never replace an already-unmapped top unit merely to reach a numeric quota

runtime_evidence.meaning: stock summon application creates classes 8D-93 and their Korean status surfaces; it does not prove that placing those IDs in fixed enemy mercenary slots preserves commands, AI, or event behavior

summon_replacement_discussion.decision_warning: the proposed scenario 26/27 ratios cannot be treated as strict stat upgrades: scenario 26 has zero and scenario 27 has only two same-family slots whose summon candidate does not reduce either base AT or base DF

hard_mode_implementation_rule.commander_stats: patch fixed-record signed modifiers after approval
hard_mode_implementation_rule.soldier_corrections: do not patch shared class records globally; after approval use a separate enemy-only expanded-ROM correction table applied after the fixed-record loader
hard_mode_implementation_rule.dynamic_event_spawns: all 63 hidden fixed records, including 53 side-04 enemy records, are represented by the 340 fixed records; event handlers can reveal or rewrite runtime records, so known rewrites and any true non-fixed spawns require an explicit exception audit before scenario approval

known_runtime_exceptions.rule: treat all ten side-08 records as hostile hard-mode targets after balance approval, but preserve side 08 and all stock event ownership
exclude this fixed record from automatic enemy bonuses because stock events change its allegiance; any hard-mode change must be runtime-event-specific and separately approved
always exclude allied Jessica from enemy hard-mode bonuses even after the event rewrites her runtime record
treat both Mina records as one transformation route and apply the approved boss rule per phase without accidental stacking
keep as a hostile final boss, but exclude it from the main-story formula and cap; tune only in the approved X4 individual policy
